scope: Proposition 5.1 (Transverse saving) of the manuscript “Endpoint pointwise convergence for the Schrodinger equation in higher dimensions” (preprints/Endpoint-pointwise-convergence-for-the-Schrodinger-equation-in-higher-dimensions-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 080 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4f859efa28f227ff), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 54. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a bounded frequency region in Rn. There are c > 0 and L0 < ∞, depending only on this region and n, such that the following configuration is impossible for L ≥ L0. Let Q be distinct unit lattice cubes in a ball of radius L2 in Rn+1, with #Q ≥ L2n−c , #{q ∈ Q : q ∩ B(z, r) ̸= ∅} ≤ Lc rn (r ≥ 1). (5.1) Suppose f1, . . . , fn+1 have L2 norm at most one, frequency support in the fixed region, and sup q |Efi| ≥ L−e−c (q ∈ Q, 1 ≤ i ≤ n + 1). It is impossible that every choice of one frequency from each support has direction determinant at least L−c in absolute value.
